The Add on Covers & Exclusions opted, Startup Cost, value of Plinth & Foundations e tc. for each Policy, wherever applicable is to be covered. There are common assets like coal handling syste m (CHS), Shore Unloader, Desalination plant, Ash handling plant, Fire protection system, Out fall Pumping system and make up water pumping system for both the units. Any liability arising due to any of the insure d perils in common assets shall be indemnified in respects of both the units. 10.1 The Indemnity Limits is as that SI of MEGA Policy. 10.2 LOP Insurance cover - Indemnity Period is 12 months While arriving at the standard generation, the Insured will make necessary adjustments for abnormal reasons, which are prevailing during the period which forms the basis for arriving at the standard generatio n but which are absent during the interruption period. 10.3 Stock Declaration policy for Coal (HCV/LCV), OIL(HFO/LDO) and stocks of Stores. 11.0 Bank Hypothecation Clause is needed for Coal, Oil & stocks of Stores Policies. 12.0 The final net Premium Rate shall be clearly indicated in the Premium Schedule only in the Price Bid (C over-II) of the offer. The net Premium Rate shall be arrived taking into account of all the items like Add on Covers, Exclusions, Start-up Cost, Claims Experience, FEA Discount, Indemnity Period for LOP Policies, any other Discounts etc as applicable for each Policy. The Premium quoted shall be inclusive of the above. After arriving at net Premium Rate, The Premium quoted shall be final. No Provisional Rate of Premium sha ll be offered. Insurers are requested to note that Discount if any, offered by the firm shall be final and no P rovisional Discount shall be offered. Discount, once offered shall not be withdrawn afterwards. 13.0 Premium Rates shall be rounded to four decimals. The Premium rate quoted shall be in Rupees per T housand Rupees only. 14.0 NTPL is not engaging any Insurance brokers. Hence, the insurance firm is requested to pass on the ‘N o Brokerage’ benefits to NTPL and the same shall be considered favorably while quoting the premium rates accordingly. Similarly, if the insurance firm prefers to extend any ot her rebates/discounts, the same shall also be considered in the Premium schedule.
